sites.capacityStatus: UNVERIFIED: exact existing registry plus serialized new bindings must fit500rows and200000bytes; no deletions or cap bypass approved

settingsPerSite.provider: Preserve configured provider; validate one request; no copied credentials
settingsPerSite.apiToken: One scoped application token only where needed, never stored in this manifest
settingsPerSite.budgetEnforcement: External orchestrator; one concurrent AI request; stop when budget reached, not a claim of built-in global caps

executionStatus: Approval allocation with concrete symbolic bindings; not executable configs. Field/status/project IDs, exact scripts/prompts and current registry bytes are mandatory preflight outputs before writes.
agentBoundary: L03 and J03 read-only get_issue+finish. No agent write/comment tools. Seed issue scope is not hard read authorization. A03 may read related records and is not a security boundary.
bulkPopulation: Temporary administrator-only bootstrap edges populate issue status without AI or creation PFs; remove and publish final graph before rule acceptance. These are temporary native Jira transitions, not extra CogniRunner rule counts.
